utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Okay, um, I think we have, maybe, two things? Scanning at deliveries and the, the rota. Noor, you wanted to start.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Yes. So, the thing with receiving stock is, it's all clipboards still, right? Which is, it's honestly wild, my cousin works at a store in, anyway, I think we get proper dedicated handheld scanners, three for each store.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Three per store? So thirty-six?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Thirty-six, yes.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Cost?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Quote was about nine hundred each, I think, last time I looked.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Last time you looked when?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Spring.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Okay.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: And they're so fast. Handhelds beat everything else for speed, they're rugged so they survive being dropped, the battery lasts a whole shift, and the warehouse people already know how to use the old ones, so training is nothing.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Fine. Do they cost more now?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: I don't know.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Find out.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I think, maybe, that's, um, reasonable? Do we decide today?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: I'd want the current quote first.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Yes, I think that's wise. Let's not decide today.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: But the clipboards are-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I know. I know. We'll decide when we have the quote.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Quote from who?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: The same supplier. Duran Scan.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Can you ask for it this week?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Yes, today.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Rota?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Right, the rota. I think, maybe, Priya, you had the changes?

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Um. Yes. Only two changes. Saturday cover at Leeds and Hull.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Okay, that seems fine?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Fine. Done.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Hold on, sorry, I just remembered, the thing about the Hull store, is the lease up? Never mind, it's not our thing.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Okay. Thanks, all.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: So, the quote. Greta, I think you got it?

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Got it. It's now eleven hundred fifty per unit, and the lead time is ten weeks. For thirty-six that's forty-one thousand four hundred, and they won't arrive until after the holiday peak.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Eleven fifty? It was nine hundred.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Prices went up. I asked.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Ten weeks is, um, really long.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: The holiday peak starts in nine. So no.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: We could get fewer units, one per store, twelve.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Then they'd be shared. Receiving happens at the same time in the mornings.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Hmm.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Can I propose something? Let's put a scanning app on the tablets and phones we already have in the stores.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: An app?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Yes. We already have forty-eight devices, for the tills and for managers. The licence is six dollars a device a month, about thirty-five hundred a year for all forty-eight. There's no hardware spend, installing takes ten minutes, and in the Leeds pilot it read ninety-eight point six percent of barcodes on the first try.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: First try, in a bright store, fine, but what about the cold room? Gloves. And a scanner is faster.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Camera scanning is a second slower. I timed it.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: A second times thousands of boxes.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Per delivery maybe six minutes extra. I did the math.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Is the Leeds pilot, um, a real thing?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: It was two stores for two weeks. Not huge.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Cheaper by a mile, though.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Cheap isn't the point, it's about speed.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: I think, um, there are good arguments. I don't want to decide right now. Can we compare properly? Henrik, can you put a one-pager together?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Yes, by Monday.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: And me?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Maybe your numbers on the speed side, with a real measurement?

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: I'll time a delivery.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Okay. Thanks.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Next week, then.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Fine.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Okay, so, both one-pagers are in. I read them last night. Let me, um, say where I am. The handhelds are faster, I accept that. But forty-one thousand, ten weeks, and, I mean, they wouldn't be here for the peak. The app is usable now. So I think, yes, we go with the scanning app on the tablets and phones we already have.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Wait, can I-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Please.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: My timing: six and a half minutes extra per delivery. Henrik was right.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: I mean it's still slower. But it's not the end of the world.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Six minutes. Fine.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Which stores first?

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Leeds again? Since they've done it.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Leeds and Hull, then the rest over three weeks.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Training?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Ten minutes a person. I'll write a card.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: I could do a video, I made one for, um, the cold chain thing, anyway-

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Yes, do the video.

utterances.speaker: Noor
utterances.text: Okay! Great.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Gloves?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Cold room people can use a phone with touch gloves. They're a few dollars.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Buy those.

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Will do.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Budget?

utterances.speaker: Henrik
utterances.text: Thirty-five hundred a year, plus gloves.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Great.

utterances.speaker: Priya
utterances.text: Can I say, I'm happy it's sorted, the clipboards were driving me a bit mad.

utterances.speaker: Greta
utterances.text: Same.

utterances.speaker: Kofi
utterances.text: Thanks, everyone.
